title: Design System: AR-9 · Computer Controlled Asset Register

display.purpose: Statement moments only: onboarding headline, 'Asset registered' stamp, admin timeline year. Uppercase, leading-none.

plate.purpose: The AR-9 model plate identity, nothing else.

body.purpose: All prose, table cells, captions; 11px caption tier in Silk Dim.

label.purpose: Uppercase 10px mono caps at 0.14em; bright (600/Silk) for module heads, dim (500/Silk Dim) elsewhere.

shadows.name: led-glow-red
shadows.purpose: Lit red LED; green uses rgba(61,220,104,0.6), amber rgba(255,176,32,0.65).

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused input: well inset plus 1px red halo, no bloom.

motion.name: entrance
motion.value: gsap fromTo opacity 0→1, y 12–20px→0, 0.35–0.45s, power2/power3.out, stagger 0.05
motion.purpose: One entrance per surface; modules rise together, then stay put.

motion.name: chase
motion.value: 620ms interval step advance around the 12-key row

motion.name: color-transition
motion.value: 150ms color/border transitions on buttons and inputs
motion.purpose: Hover/focus state changes; color only, never position or shadow.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation/transition durations to 0.01ms, one iteration
motion.purpose: Global kill switch including blink and chase.

components.name: Primary Panel Button
components.description: The red panel switch: primary actions in the RUN/CLEAR vocabulary.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #ff3b30; color: #000; border: 1px solid #ff3b30; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ff554b; border-color: #ff554b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3b30; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Panel Button
components.description: Hairline-bordered transparent switch for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; color: #bdbdbd; border: 1px solid #33333b; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #f2f2f2; border-color: #85858e; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3b30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel Input
components.description: A recessed well with a red caret; focus turns the border red with a 1px halo.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; background: #0a0a0c; color: #f2f2f2; caret-color: #ff3b30; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding: 10px 12px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8a92; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #ff3b30; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,59,48,0.4); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-module { background: #1a1a1e; border: 1px solid #26262c; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03) inset, 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); color: #f2f2f2; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; } .ds-module-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #26262c; padding: 10px 16px; } .ds-module-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-silk-bright { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #bdbdbd; margin: 0; } .ds-silk { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8a92; }

components.name: Status LED
components.description: The 8px lamp: dark at rest; red/green/amber lit with glow; blink for pending.
components.css: .ds-led { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: #3a3a40; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-led-red { background: #ff3b30; box-shadow: 0 0 6px 1px rgba(255,59,48,0.7), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-led-green { background: #3ddc68; box-shadow: 0 0 6px 1px rgba(61,220,104,0.6), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-led-amber { background: #ffb020; box-shadow: 0 0 6px 1px rgba(255,176,32,0.65), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-led-blink { animation: ds-led-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-led-blink { 0%, 60% { opacity: 1; } 61%, 100% { opacity: 0.25; } }

components.name: Step Key
components.description: A pressable rhythm-machine keycap with a lit window; unlit keys keep their hue at low lightness.
components.css: .ds-step-key { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 64px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.6); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18); background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.14), rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 100ms; user-select: none; } .ds-step-key:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12); } .ds-key-red { background-color: #e0342a; } .ds-key-red.ds-key-unlit { background-color: #63201b; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.07), rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%); } .ds-key-window { position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); top: 14%; width: 34%; height: 10%; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); } .ds-key-window-lit { background: #fff7f0; box-shadow: 0 0 8px 2px rgba(255,235,200,0.85), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-key-count { position: absolute; bottom: 6px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); } .ds-key-count-dim { position: absolute; bottom: 6px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; color: rgba(242,242,242,0.4); }

components.name: Segment Window
components.description: A recessed right-aligned well framing the SVG 7-segment readout (digits + en-IN separators only, no ₹ glyph).
components.css: .ds-seg-window { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; overflow: hidden; background: #0a0a0c; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-seg-value { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 28px; color: #ff3b30; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255,59,48,0.7); transform: skewX(-4deg); letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

components.description: 24 segments, 3px gaps, lit proportionally in a step-key hue — the register-share meter.
components.css: .ds-meter { display: flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-meter-seg { width: 8px; height: 10px; border-radius: 1px; background: #26262c; } .ds-meter-seg.ds-lit { background: #ff3b30; }

narrative.overview:
Every surface is the faceplate of an early-80s rhythm machine. Records are steps you arm, acknowledgement is a lit LED, the year is a twelve-key step row, and totals read off 7-segment LED windows. The world is a single matte charcoal instrument: raised modules on a panel, recessed display wells, physical keycaps, silkscreened caps labels. It explicitly refuses the white-card SaaS dashboard with an indigo accent.

Density is instrument-grade: small mono type, tight silkscreen labels, hairline seams between modules, tabular numerals everywhere numbers appear. Color is scarce and semantic — the step-key quartet (red / orange / yellow / white) and two status LEDs (green / amber) are the only chroma on an otherwise near-black panel. Light is the interface's voice: the only glow anywhere comes from lit LEDs, lit segments, and key windows.

Mode is Operate on all three surfaces (login, onboarding, admin console). The product identity is the AR-9 model plate (Michroma), owned by the Qugen Pathlabs group.
keyCharacteristics: Matte charcoal hardware panel with brushed-plastic grain on the chassis
Step-key quartet accents cycled Q1→Q4 (red, orange, yellow, white)
LED glow as the only glow; red 7-segment readouts, amber only for pending
Silkscreen-gray mono caps labels (10px, 0.14em) as the labeling voice
Physicality via raised modules, recessed wells, and pressable keycaps — never floating cards

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow (box-shadow bloom or SVG drop-shadow) appears only on lit LEDs, lit 7-segment content, lit key windows, and the chase light. Text, borders, buttons, and cards never glow.

rules.name: The Amber Pending Rule
rules.body: Pending = amber LED blinking + amber readout. Acknowledged = green LED steady. Every other readout is red. Amber and green never appear outside status.

rules.name: The Silkscreen Floor Rule
rules.body: Tertiary silkscreen text never drops below #85858e — that value holds 4.5:1 on module surfaces.

rules.name: The Hue-Preserved Unlit Rule
rules.body: Unlit step keys use dedicated low-lightness variants of their own hue (#63201b / #63400a / #5d520c / #595955) — never brightness() or saturate() filters, which muddy the hue.

rules.name: The Earned Anton Rule
rules.body: Anton appears only at moments of statement; on the admin console exactly one — the timeline year. If a heading can be a silkscreen label, it is one.

rules.name: The Tabular Instrument Rule
rules.body: Every numeric column and inline count uses tabular-nums; numbers read as instrument readouts.

rules.name: The Faceplate Rule
rules.body: Elevation states physical construction (raised / recessed / pressable), never hierarchy or hover flair. Hover changes color or border, never shadow or position — the only positional response is the keycap's 1px press.

dos: Do keep every glow attached to a light source — LEDs, lit segments, key windows, the chase light (The One Glow Rule).
Do format currency as ₹ + en-IN grouping with zero decimals via inr(); segment displays get digits + en-IN separators only via segDigits() — never a ₹ glyph in LED cells.
Do speak status in LED vocabulary: pending = amber blinking, acknowledged/healthy = green steady, readouts otherwise red.
Do label with silkscreen caps (10px mono, 0.14em) and keep tertiary text at or above #85858e.
Do draw icons as inline SVG in the Heroicons manner (1.5–2 stroke); size chart and meter color from the step-key quartet, cycled in order.
Do keep motion state-conveying and short: 150–300ms GSAP entrances (power2/power3.out, opacity + ≤20px rise), the 620ms chase, the 1.1s LED blink — all collapsed under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do group location data by name, not id — historical duplicate location rows share a name.
donts: Don't build white cards, light surfaces, or an indigo/blue accent — the refused SaaS dashboard is the anti-reference.
Don't use Anton outside statement moments, or Michroma outside the AR-9 plate; no proportional or system display faces anywhere.
Don't dim keys or accents with brightness()/saturate() filters — use the hue-preserved unlit variants.
Don't add hover elevation, floating shadows, or glowing text/borders/buttons; hover changes color only, and only keycaps move (1px press).
Don't use unicode glyphs or icon fonts as icons.
Don't put amber or green anywhere except status LEDs and the pending readout.
